basic_details.job_title: DCPU SAS Nagar Support Person Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The District Child Protection Unit, S.A.S Nagar (ਦਫ਼ਤਰ ਜ਼ਿਲ੍ਹਾ ਬਾਲ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ ਯੂਨਿਟ ਐਸ.ਏ.ਐਸ ਨਗਰ) is inviting applications for a total of 5 Support Persons on honorarium basis under the Model Guidelines with respect to support persons under section 39 of the POCSO Act. Applications go only by registered post to the Office of District Child Protection Officer, S.A.S Nagar, and the last date and time is 27 November 2026, 5:00 PM. Interested applicants or institutions may apply.

important_instructions: The posts are purely temporary and on honorarium basis. Within the district, in a case registered under the POCSO Act, the Child Welfare Committee will appoint one Support Person in one case. There is no possibility of these posts being made regular or permanent. A minimum of two Support Persons shall be empanelled in each district, with additional empanelment based on the district-wise POCSO case load. Any amendment to the recruitment notice will be published on the district website https://sasnagar.nic.in, where more information about the recruitment is also available.

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the honorarium amount or the application fee.

rows.details: District Child Protection Unit, S.A.S Nagar
Support Person (under section 39 of the POCSO Act)
Honorarium basis (as shown on the district website)
Graduation (minimum 60% marks) in Psychology, Social Work, Sociology, Child Development, Psychiatry, Counselling, Human Rights, Criminology or Law
21 to 65 years on the date of publication of the advertisement

content_sections.heading: About DCPU SAS Nagar
content_sections.text: The District Child Protection Unit, S.A.S Nagar works under the District Child Protection Officer, whose office is in the District Administrative Complex, S.A.S Nagar. The recruitment notice is issued over the name of the Deputy Commissioner, S.A.S Nagar, and the terms and conditions are signed by the District Child Protection Officer, S.A.S Nagar, on 20 November 2026. The Support Persons are engaged under the Model Guidelines with respect to support persons under section 39 of the POCSO Act, and the selection criteria retain all eligibility conditions prescribed in the NCPCR Model Guidelines.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Office of District Child Protection Officer, Room No. 536, 4th Floor, District Administrative Complex, S.A.S Nagar - 160055 Fill in the "Application Performa" printed with the notice (pages 4 and 5 of the PDF). In the form, give the post applied for, your name and father's name in block letters, date of birth, gender, marital status, postal address, contact number and email address, and paste a photograph in the box provided. Fill in the educational qualification table (exam passed, board or university, year of passing, maximum marks, marks obtained, percentage). Fill in the professional experience table starting from the current job (institution, designation, part time, contract, ad hoc, regular or permanent basis, exact dates, total period and nature of duties). List your enclosures in the "Details of enclosures" table and sign the declaration with date and place. Send the application by registered post to the address above so that it is received by 27 November 2026, 5:00 PM. If the last date for filling the form falls on a government holiday, the date of receiving applications will be the next working day.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for 5 Support Persons on honorarium basis. The eligibility conditions listed in the selection criteria are: Preferences printed in the notice: Preference shall be given to women candidates. Preference to candidates having experience in child protection, counselling, psychology, social work or legal aid. Pay: the posts are on purely honorarium basis. The notice says applications are invited on the basis of the salary, age and educational qualification shown on the website of District S.A.S Nagar, and that the honorarium will be paid from time to time if budget is available from the Government of India and the State Government. The honorarium amount is not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions for the post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: According to the selection criteria for Support Persons, assessment is made on the basis of academic qualifications, relevant experience and interview, while retaining all eligibility conditions prescribed in the NCPCR Model Guidelines. The office section of the application form records the percentage of marks and experience marks for each applicant. The selection committee reserves the full right to fill or not to fill these posts, and the full final authority regarding the recruitment rests with the Deputy Commissioner, S.A.S Nagar.

faq.question: Q1. How many Support Person vacancies are there in DCPU SAS Nagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The District Child Protection Unit, S.A.S Nagar has invited applications for a total of 5 Support Persons under section 39 of the POCSO Act.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the SAS Nagar Support Person posts?
faq.answer: The last date and time is 27 November 2026, 5:00 PM; if that day is a government holiday, applications will be received on the next working day.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Support Person post?
faq.answer: Candidates need Graduation (minimum 60% marks) in Psychology, Social Work, Sociology, Child Development, Psychiatry, Counselling, Human Rights, Criminology or Law.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for DCPU SAS Nagar Support Persons?
faq.answer: The applicant must be not less than 21 years and not more than 65 years on the date of publication of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the SAS Nagar Support Person posts?
faq.answer: Send the filled Application Performa only by registered post to the Office of District Child Protection Officer, Room No. 536, 4th Floor, District Administrative Complex, S.A.S Nagar - 160055.

faq.question: Q6. How will Support Persons be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is based on academic qualifications, relevant experience and interview, retaining all eligibility conditions in the NCPCR Model Guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. Is the DCPU SAS Nagar Support Person post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the posts are purely temporary and on honorarium basis, and the notice says there is no possibility of these posts being made regular or permanent.

faq.question: Q8. Who gets preference in the Support Person selection?
faq.answer: Preference shall be given to women candidates, and preference is also given to candidates with experience in child protection, counselling, psychology, social work or legal aid.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside S.A.S Nagar district apply?
faq.answer: The candidate should be a resident of, or working in, the same district, and should have adequate knowledge of the local language.
